title: Fourier norm of odd majority
statement: For every nonnegative integer $m$, the Fourier one-norm of the real-valued majority function on $2m+1$ sign coordinates equals $\mathbb{E}[1/(2J+1)]\,((2m+1)/2^m)\binom{2m}{m}$, where $J$ has the binomial distribution with parameters $m$ and $1/2$.
